enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +12: Passive: +12 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Lightning Lore +12: Passive: Your Electricity spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Magnetism +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Insightful Magnetism +42: Passive: +42 Insight bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +4: +4 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Fusible: Something about this item looks incomplete. Perhaps in the future it will be compatible with another item to create a brand-new fusion of the two.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
